chung.Syllabus Name: Python Web Development_Phát triển Web với Python
chung.Learning-Teaching Method: In-class lecture, Social Constructivism, Active Learning
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description: By the end of this course, students will be able to build and deploy a complete Flask-based web application from scratch: they will understand core web concepts such as the client–server model and HTTP, create routes and view functions, design dynamic pages with Jinja2 templates and Bootstrap, build secure web forms with validation and CSRF protection, and work with databases using pyodbc and SQLAlchemy (including CRUD, migrations, and relationships). Students will also implement authentication, session management, and role-based authorization, develop real-world features like user profiles, blog posts, feeds, and comments, create RESTful APIs with JSON, AJAX, and JWT, handle errors and middleware/decorator patterns, and apply testing and basic containerization to confidently ship a production-ready Flask application.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
chung.Tools:
- Language: Python 3.11+

- Web framework: Flask

- Database: SQL Server 2019+

- Tool: pyodbc, Flask-SQLAlchemy

- Other: Docker

- AI Tool: Github Copilot or tools specified by the Subject Leader
